title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Appointment
description: An Appointment is an arrangement to do something or meet someone at a particular time, at a place (for face to face appointment) or in a contact medium (for phone appointment). (TM Forum TMF646 Appointment 4.0.0, Swagger definition Appointment; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Appointment:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Appointment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Appointment:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the appointment

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/href'. Unique URI used to access to the appointment resource

category.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/category'. Business category : intervention for example or to be more precise after SalesIntervention, orderDeliveryIntervention,...

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/description'. Short free text describing the appointment

externalId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/externalId'. External reference known by the customer

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/lastUpdate'. Date of last appointment update

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/attachment'. A calendar event reference (CalendarEventRef). The appointment is associated with a calendar event (an happening at a point of time) associated to a calendar entry.

note.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF646_AppointmentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF646-Appointment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Appointment/properties/note'. Extra information about a given entity

relatedPlace.description: Property. Related place defines (by reference or value) the place where the appointment will take place.
